title: compile_context
description: PRIMARY tool: compile a budgeted Evidence Pack for a question (intent→plan→select→pack+EXPLAIN). Prefer one compile_context over ten reads/greps. Returns SCOPE_UNRESOLVED if anchors are missing; BUDGET_EXCEEDED if must-include cannot fit.

remaining_context_tokens.description: Agent remaining context; compiler uses min(budget_tokens, remaining)

progressive.description: Include architecture-first progressive layers in the result

require_precise.description: For impact/refactor accuracy claims: require T2 overlay or PRECISION_REQUIRED
